name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio:
Mateo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in Buenos Aires, captivated by Formula 1 races broadcasted on television. He pursued a degree in Aeronautical Engineering at the Instituto Tecnológico de Buenos Aires, excelling in aerodynamics and fluid dynamics. Upon graduation, Mateo secured a position at a local racing team, where he honed his skills in wind tunnel testing and computational fluid dynamics (CFD). His dedication and innovative approach quickly earned him recognition, leading to opportunities in European racing series.

Before joining Allied Racing, Mateo spent several years working with a smaller F3 team, where he was instrumental in developing a cutting-edge aero package that significantly improved the car's performance. His ability to identify and exploit subtle aerodynamic advantages is highly valued. As Head of Aero at Allied Racing, Mateo is determined to lead the team to new heights, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and pushing the boundaries of aerodynamic innovation.

Mateo's visionary leadership style, coupled with his practical experience, makes him a unique asset to the team. He believes in empowering his team members, encouraging them to experiment and think outside the box. He is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his relentless pursuit of aerodynamic excellence.
